I saw your post for the Graphic Designer role, and I like that the position focuses on both independent execution and team collaboration.

For a detailed look at my work, my Bounceless case study shows a cleaner verification experience for teams, which you can see at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

Ananya
